meta.name: ui-ux-pro-max
meta.description: UI/UX design intelligence for web and mobile. Searchable local database with 84 styles, 192 color palettes, 74 font pairings, 192 product types, 98 UX guidelines, 104 icon entries, 16 GSAP motion presets, and 25 chart types across 22 stacks (React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt, Svelte, Astro, SwiftUI, React Native, Flutter, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Jetpack Compose, Angular, Laravel, JavaFX, WPF, WinUI, Avalonia, Uno Platform, UWP, Three.js, and HTML/CSS). Use when designing, building, or reviewing UI: pages, components, color schemes, typography, layout, accessibility, animation, or data visualization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查找 UI 样式、配色、字体和动效参考
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在设计或评审网页和移动端 UI 时需要灵感与规范参考。
copy.tagline_en: Find UI styles, color palettes, fonts, and motion references
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need inspiration and guidelines when designing or reviewing UI for web and mobile.

howto.what: Claude 会使用内置的 UI/UX 设计规则数据库，根据你的需求推荐样式、配色、字体、布局、动画等，并生成设计系统文件。
howto.when: 当你设计、构建或审查网页或移动应用的 UI，包括页面、组件、配色、排版、布局、可访问性、动画或数据可视化时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个美容 SPA 网站的首页设计系统。
为这个仪表盘页面推荐配色方案和字体搭配。
say.note: Claude 会查询配色和字体数据库并给出建议。

say.text: 检查这个登录表单的可访问性和交互反馈。
say.note: Claude 会依据 UX 指南进行审查。

howto.what_en: Claude uses a built-in UI/UX design rules database to recommend styles, color palettes, fonts, layouts, animations, etc., and generates design system files based on your needs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you design, build, or review UI for web or mobile apps, including pages, components, color schemes, typography, layout, accessibility, animation, or data visualization.

say_en.text: Design a homepage design system for a beauty spa website.
say_en.note: Claude runs the design system search and generates a MASTER.md file.

say_en.text: Recommend color palettes and font pairings for this dashboard page.
say_en.note: Claude queries the color and typography databases and gives suggestions.

say_en.text: Review this login form for accessibility and interaction feedback.
